entities.summary: Gulnara Shahinian is an Armenian diplomat and author who studies human trafficking. She is a member of the Group of Experts on Action Against Trafficking in Human Beings and the former United Nations Special Rapporteur on Contemporary Forms of Slavery from 2006 until 2014.
